subject.title: fix: honor outbound hooks in Control UI chat replies

question: Should Control UI chat adopt the established outbound `message_sending` contract, including allowing plugin cancellation to suppress the visible and persisted assistant reply?
rationale: The implementation is a bounded repair, but it intentionally expands existing plugin hook effects to a persisted Control UI surface and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Accept consistent hook coverage
options.body: Merge after confirming that Control UI should honor the same rewrite and cancellation policy as other outbound reply surfaces.
